name: DoubtNix
summary: A full-stack document Q&A platform that returns LLM-generated answers over uploaded material, with document parsing pushed off the request cycle.
points: Built and deployed a full-stack document Q&A platform returning LLM-generated answers via the Gemini API, with the backend hosted on AWS EC2.
Moved document parsing and post-processing into an async event-driven pipeline, decoupling heavy work from the request cycle.
Secured with 3-layer auth — JWT, OTP, and 2FA — plus session management.
Cloudinary-based file storage, with a React and TanStack Query frontend.

name: Sync-Chat
summary: 1:1 and group messaging over Socket.IO with a Redis Pub/Sub adapter, so events stay in sync across multiple server instances.
points: Built 1:1 and group messaging with Socket.IO and a Redis Pub/Sub adapter so events sync across multiple server instances for horizontal scaling; backend on AWS EC2.
Implemented JWT cookie auth with refresh-token rotation and 3-role group RBAC (owner / admin / member).
Built multi-device presence tracking and typing indicators.
Added VAPID web push notifications for offline users.
